pr_title: resolve: follow-up for synthesizing empty name
pr_body:
Follow-up for #22231.
Closes #22401.

Before this PR.
```
$ dig -t SRV '.'

; <<>> DiG 9.16.24-RH <<>> -t SRV .
;; global options: +cmd
;; Got answer:
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 16836
;; flags: qr aa rd ra ad; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 0, ADDITIONAL: 1

;; OPT PSEUDOSECTION:
; EDNS: version: 0, flags:; udp: 65494
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;.				IN	SRV

;; Query time: 1 msec
;; SERVER: 127.0.0.53#53(127.0.0.53)
;; WHEN: Fri Feb 04 12:01:09 JST 2022
;; MSG SIZE  rcvd: 28
```

After this PR.
```
$ dig -t SRV '.'

; <<>> DiG 9.16.24-RH <<>> -t SRV .
;; global options: +cmd
;; Got answer:
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 19861
;; flags: qr rd ra ad; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 1, ADDITIONAL: 1

;; OPT PSEUDOSECTION:
; EDNS: version: 0, flags:; udp: 65494
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;.				IN	SRV

;; AUTHORITY SECTION:
.			86394	IN	SOA	a.root-servers.net. nstld.verisign-grs.com. 2022020302 1800 900 604800 86400

;; Query time: 20 msec
;; SERVER: 127.0.0.53#53(127.0.0.53)
;; WHEN: Fri Feb 04 12:00:12 JST 2022
;; MSG SIZE  rcvd: 103
```

issue_context.title: resolved: new handling of root domain looks wrong
issue_context.body:
This is mostly a tracking bug because I think #22231 isn't right. i.e. it should probably only synthesize NXDOMAIN for A/AAAA lookups in the root zone, but let all other root zone lookups through as is, so that DNSSEC can work.

But I didn't test this, this is just an issue I am pretty sure exists, based on looking at the change.

review_comments: maybe add `assert(match >= 0);` here, encoding the assumption that this can never fail.
